definitions.gloss: coming and going; traffic; passage of people
definitions.explanation: The movement of people or vehicles back and forth along a route. Refers to the flow of traffic or pedestrians.
A road or street where people pass through, especially a public road in a town. A somewhat traditional or literary word for street.

notes:
USAGE:
{往来|おうらい} combines {往|おう} (going) and {来|らい} (coming). It can function as a noun or as a suru verb ({往来|おうらい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ = to come and go). Sense 2 (street) has a somewhat old-fashioned feel.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{往来|おうらい} (foot traffic)
- ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{往来|おうらい} (vehicle traffic)
- {往来|おうらい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧ (heavy traffic)
- {往来|おうらい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{面|めん}する→面する：14629_mensuru⟧ (to face the street)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧ is the standard modern word for traffic and transportation. {往来|おうらい} has a more traditional feel and specifically emphasizes the back-and-forth movement of people.
